Practice Note for Authorized Persons,
Buildings Department     Registered Structural Engineers and        ADM-5
                          Registered Geotechnical Engineers


                               Submissions
                            to the Buildings Department


          Many submissions received by the Buildings Department are subject to
statutory time limits. Receipt points for various types of submissions in paper format are
outlined below:

            Submissions                          Receipt Points
  (i)  Submissions   relating   to  new   Receipt and Dispatch Counter  at  the
      building    developments    and    office of New Buildings Divisions on 7/F,
      alteration  and   addition  works   14 Taikoo Wan Road, Taikoo Shing,
      (except for works in response to a   Hong Kong
      statutory order, notice, direction or
     an  advisory   letter   related   to
      building or slope safety)

  (ii) Other Submissions                  General Enquiry and Receipt Counter at
                                            the Buildings Department Headquarters
                                    on G/F, North Tower, West Kowloon
                                    Government Offices, 11 Hoi Ting Road,
                                Yau Ma Tei, Kowloon

2.          The operating hours of the above counters are:

           Mondays to Fridays 8:30 am to 5:30 pm

3.         To facilitate efficient working of the time-stamp machine, we would
appreciate  your  co-operation  in  folding  your  plans  in  the manner  indicated  in
Appendix A.





                                                                                                 /4. …

4.           For submissions in electronic format, please refer to Practice Note for
Authorized Persons, Registered  Structural Engineers and Registered Geotechnical
Engineers (PNAP) ADM-17 and PNAP APP-60 for details.





                                                             ( YU Po-mei, Clarice )
                                                Building Authority





Ref. : BD GR/1-135/1
This PNAP is previously known as PNAP-58
First issue     April 1979
Last revision  March 2019
This revision May 2022 (AD/CS) (Paragraph 1 amended and paragraph 4 added)
